purpose: Record an authenticated accountable offering-owner decision about beginning a bounded professional/service engagement without creating software runtime/admissibility authority.

ALLOW: exact DELIVERY_ADMISSION_EVIDENCE_SATISFIED is bound to the same engagement/offering/proposal/version
accountable offering owner is authentically identified and has existing business/operational authority for the bounded service engagement
all offering-specific non-runtime start predicates are satisfied
decision evidence is attributable, timestamped and retained
decision scope does not exceed accepted scope or offering maturity
DENY: accountable owner affirmatively refuses the bounded service start or an established blocking condition applies
FAIL_CLOSED: accountable owner identity/authority cannot be established
exact engagement/admission evidence cannot be bound
decision evidence cannot be authenticated or retained

runtime_separation.rule: SERVICE_DELIVERY_AUTHORIZED does not authorize consequential software execution. Each runtime/admissibility/provider/credential/custody action remains independently gated by its existing native owner and evidence contract.
examples: StegGate commitment evaluation remains canonical StegCore admissibility
StegCRM source write-back remains separately admitted
Ecosystem Chat provider/runtime invocation remains separate
StegLearn external provider/media integration remains separate

owner_evidence_sources: StegBusiness governance domain: governing authority structure and governing persons/roles
StegBusiness contract domain: contracting entity, counterparty, scope/term/value, signature authority and lifecycle state
StegBusiness-Ops operational workflows/receipts supporting business state transitions
exact accepted proposal/SOW and offering package fulfillment semantics
prohibitions: Does not authorize or begin any real delivery by schema existence
Does not execute software or invoke runtime
Does not create Task Registry/COSV authority
Does not create a new dispatcher, hosted service or authority plane
